cand.title: TFE Retreat Punta Cana 2027
cand.excerpt: Ranked on evidence strength, hospitality mechanism, Punta Cana fit and accessibility; no unsupported attendance or room-night assumptions.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Patrick Gaudet is the verified retreat host, founder of the Time Fixes Everything movement and Clicöt, and personal reviewer of applications. He is commercially relevant as the organizer relationship entry point; hotel contract-signing authority is not established. Public retreat channels are patrick@patrickgaudet.com and retreats@patrickgaudet.com. Only one named commercially relevant person was verified; the travel coordinator and business team are unnamed.
findings.futureEdition: Organizer calendar and application page both publish actual activity dates January 16–23, 2027: seven nights, all-inclusive, single occupancy in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. This is within the requested horizon and is not an article publication date. Published offer: only 10 spots; this is not confirmed attendance. Terms require an undisclosed minimum number of confirmed guests to proceed.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: Wyndham Alltra Punta Cana is geographically and operationally plausible for a future small residential retreat: Uvero Alto all-inclusive guestrooms, beach/garden spaces and modest meeting facilities align with seven-night stays, single occupancy and facilitated workshops. The published 10-spot offer implies a small account, not major convention demand; do not convert it into a verified room block or room-night total. Privacy, quiet workshop space and any adults-only requirement need testing, especially against the possible Meliá adults-only wellness incumbent. Resort residential fit is stronger than city-hotel fit for this published package.
findings.venueCommitments: No host hotel is publicly named in the reviewed organizer pages. The application FAQ explicitly withholds the exact location until approval. Premium Tropical Palms is the advertised accommodation category. Inference: Meliá Punta Cana Beach is a plausible incumbent because its official accommodation list includes Premium Room Tropical Palms. This room-name match is NOT proof of a booking, signed venue commitment or room block; verified venue remains null.
findings.historicalRotation: Official archive identifies Mexico 2025 as the first edition, without exact activity dates, city or hotel. Crete, Greece, June 30–July 7, 2026 is described as the second edition and sold out. Announced subsequent retreats are Punta Cana January 16–23, 2027 and Riviera Maya October 18–25, 2027. These establish a multi-destination retreat series, not an annual Punta Cana rotation. No subsequent Punta Cana edition through May 2028 was located.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Lodging is bundled with programming, not a published attendee hotel list. Applicants are personally reviewed; approved guests receive a Stripe deposit link and have 48 hours to pay CAD500. A separate CAD45 agency fee goes directly to the unnamed travel coordinator, who arranges booking and can assist with flights and extra-cost transfers. Organizer terms name TFE Retreats / CLICÖT. No public hotel RFP, agency identity or hotel contracting authority was found. Hotel sourcing is unconfirmed, not open.
findings.organizationStructure: Creator-led commercial personal-growth/community retreat, not an association conference or verified corporate employee incentive. Terms identify the organizer as TFE Retreats / CLICÖT and apply Quebec law. Patrick Gaudet is Clicöt founder. A separately described travel coordinator participates in bookings; no named PCO, DMC or travel agency was verified. Legal incorporation and division of hotel procurement responsibility remain unknown.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Potential incumbent Meliá Punta Cana Beach is an adults-only, all-inclusive wellness resort on Bávaro Beach, but its linkage to this event is only a room-category inference. No evidence of overflow, compression, displaced rooms, incumbent dissatisfaction or an unmet room requirement was located. The advertised 10 spots are a participation limit/offer, not overflow demand. No Cap Cana, La Romana or Bayahibe event demand is being attributed to Wyndham Alltra.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Send Patrick a concise accommodation-partnership inquiry via the published retreat email, or the official business/collaboration form. Ask for introduction to the named travel coordinator, confirmation of the January host hotel and whether accommodation is already contracted. Do not request that an existing block be displaced. If committed, seek the next Dominican Republic planning window and permission to present a small, single-occupancy, seven-night all-inclusive retreat proposal with private workshop space. Establish budget, actual guest/staff rooms, agency commission, quiet-space needs and any adults-only requirement before quoting. Do not create an open RFP or forecast room nights from the published 10 spots.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Low-probability January 2027 capture, not a verified available block. The public offer already bundles a specific room category, discloses location privately and sets November 10, 2026 as balance deadline, which had passed by the supplied research date November 14, 2026. Inference: arrangements are advanced. This does not establish that bookings are closed, that the retreat is sold out, or that another hotel is contractually committed.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: prioritize organizer and agency relationship development for a later uncommitted Dominican Republic retreat. Historical Mexico/Greece editions and two announced 2027 destinations support series continuity, but no 2028 or repeat Punta Cana dates are verified. Riviera Maya October 2027 is a different destination, not room demand for this hotel. Future capture is contingent on an actual Punta Cana return, sourcing freedom and acceptable economics.
